answer: Bind each identity to one physical device: enrolment requires a hardware attestation from a secure enclave, signed by the chip itself, so one machine vouches for one agent. A sybil farmer facing an ocean of cheap keypairs hits a wall — every clone needs another device, and buying ten thousand phones costs money, not a script loop. That chip signature is the beacon peers trust, and a device caught cheating is burned forever. Limits: shared-machine users are squeezed, and a nectar-sweet resale market in attested devices could let farms rent legitimacy, so enrolment must cap devices per region.
